source: claude-code subagent (viewed all 4 contact sheets + profile + transcript)
summary: A 31-minute 'pov' diary of a working trip through Australia (hinterland, Melbourne, Sydney). A ~25 s teaser with a song (forest walk, a yellow 'MELBOURNE' card, cooking) leads into a four-minute garden sit-down with a notebook, where he reviews his year and plans. The middle is talk-heavy home and apartment footage (night desk monologues lit by screens and lamps, low-angle laptop talks) broken by 'FLIGHT DAY' and '9AM' cards. The set piece is a Melbourne fan meetup announced by an Instagram story. It ends with a walking-then-standing monologue in a Sydney car park, ending 'thank you for watching'.
hook_analysis: Music teaser rather than a spoken claim: forest walk (0:00), a rounded-frame street shot with bold yellow 'MELBOURNE' (0:10) and kitchen prep (0:20) under captioned song lyrics; speech begins ~0:03 under the music and the premise ('currently down in Australia') arrives by ~0:30. The hook is the place card and the personality, not jeopardy.
narrative_arc: Chronological: hinterland reflection on the year (0:30-4:18) -> friends at a brick loft (5:08-6:07) -> notebook 'golden rule' (6:17) -> plan to fly to Melbourne (7:46) -> night work talks (8:36-12:54) -> FLIGHT DAY (13:04) -> apartment desk talk on business systems (14:13-17:41) -> story announcing a meetup (17:51) -> street meetup and group photo (18:11-23:29) -> 9AM rental car (25:08-26:07) -> Sydney walk and car-park monologue on a 'North star' (26:37-30:45).
camera_and_composition: Locked-off wide-angle medium on a low stool in a garden (0:30-4:18); ultra-wide upward selfies with ceiling lights (4:28-4:48, 14:03); close desk framing with screen reflection in glasses (9:55-12:54); low-angle laptop-cam framing against bright windows (14:13-17:41); eye-level handheld two-shots at the meetup (18:11-23:39). Rounded-corner inserts at 0:10, 13:24, 19:21, 25:57. Exact cuts/moves not observable at storyboard resolution.
color_and_grade: Warm, natural greens by day; nights are dark amber with practical lamps (27% low-key frames). Street scenes in Melbourne are bright, punchy daylight. Modest contrast, warm bias (warmth 0.087).
sound_and_music: Densest talk of the set: ~98% speech coverage at ~176 wpm. Music is a bed under the teaser (song lyrics captioned) and a short speech-free passage around 26:05-26:18. Captions occasionally carry speaker handles ('@brunocasanovas', '@matthardybrown').
what_to_borrow: 10-20 s teaser with a bold yellow place card before the talk
Day/time cards ('FLIGHT DAY', '9AM') as chapter markers
Name the people on screen in caption form with their handle
Use the fan meetup as the film's social set piece, set up earlier by a story screenshot
End with a standing to-camera wrap in a neutral location
what_to_avoid_copying: Four-minute static garden sit-down at the top - for travel films cover it with b-roll
Long night monologues lit by a laptop screen (9:55-12:54)
Calls to action (email list) inside the story
